**Leads Page Requirements**

**![][image1]**

The Leads page should be the main database for all leads. Users can view leads in Table or Pipeline view, search, filter, import, add, export, select all, and update lead fields.

KPIs

* Total Leads \= all active leads in pipeline  
* New Leads \= leads created in selected timeframe  
* Hot Leads \= leads with high AI score / high intent  
* Needs Reply \= leads waiting for agent response

When user clicks Filter buttons the lead list should show the leads with these specific tags

* Hot Leads  
* Needs Reply  
* Buyers  
* Sellers  
* AI Active  
* AI Recommended  
* Appointment Set

Search should work by name, email, phone, type, status, source, area.

Lead Fields  
 Each lead should have:

* Name  
* Lead Type: Buyer, Seller, Unknown, Both, Investor, Renter, Agent Referral  
* Stage: New Lead, Contacted, Engaged, Qualified, Appointment Set, Active Client, Under Contract, Closed, Lost  
* AI Status: AI Off, Automation Only, AI Active, AI Paused, Awaiting Reply, Human Takeover, Appointment Booked, AI Complete  
* Source: Zillow, Realtor.com, Open House, Cold Calling, Website, Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram, Referral, Imported, Inbound SMS, Manual, CRM Import, Other  
* Budget: Under $300K, $300K-$500K, $500K-$750K, $750K-$1M, $1M+  
* Area  
* AI Score

AI Auto-Updates  
 AI should update lead fields automatically based on inbox conversations, calls, replies, and lead behavior.

Examples:

* Lead asks about buying → Type \= Buyer  
* Lead asks about selling → Type \= Seller  
* Lead mentions budget → Budget updates  
* Lead mentions city/neighborhood → Area updates  
* Lead replies → Stage can move to Engaged  
* Lead answers qualification questions → Stage moves to Qualified  
* Lead books showing/meeting → Stage \= Appointment Set, AI Status \= Appointment Booked  
* Lead stops replying → AI Status \= Awaiting Reply or Human Takeover if needed  
* Deal closes → Stage \= Closed

Stage Score  
 AI score should be influenced by stage:

* Lost \= 5%  
* New Lead \= 10%  
* Contacted \= 25%  
* Engaged \= 45%  
* Qualified \= 65%  
* Appointment Set \= 80%  
* Active Client \= 90%  
* Under Contract \= 98%  
* Closed \= 100%

AI Score should also consider recent activity, intent, replies, missed calls, appointment intent, and urgency.

Manual Override  
 User can manually change any field. AI can suggest updates, but user changes should save and not be overwritten unless new conversation data clearly supports it.

Goal  
 The Leads page should stay automatically organized by AI so agents do not have to manually update every lead.

**Pipeline View Requirements**

**View Image and requirements below**

**![][image2]**

Pipeline is a visual representation of where every lead is in the sales process. Leads move left → right as they get closer to closing.

### Pipeline Stages

New Lead (10%)

* Lead just entered WarmChats.  
* No meaningful conversation yet.

Contacted (25%)

* First outreach sent or first contact made.  
* SMS, email, call, or AI response.

Engaged (45%)

* Lead is actively replying.  
* Conversation is happening.

Qualified (65%)

* AI or agent gathered key information.  
* Timeline, budget, area, motivation, etc.

Appointment Set (80%)

* Showing, consultation, listing appointment, or meeting booked.

Active Client (90%)

* Lead is now an active buyer, seller, renter, or investor client.

Under Contract (98%)

* Offer accepted or contract signed.

Closed (100%)

* Deal successfully closed.

Lost (5%)

* Lead is dead, unresponsive, or went with someone else.

### AI Automation

AI should automatically move leads through stages based on conversation activity.

Examples:

* Lead replies → Engaged  
* AI gathers qualification info → Qualified  
* Appointment booked → Appointment Set  
* Agent marks active buyer/seller → Active Client  
* Contract signed → Under Contract  
* Deal closes → Closed

### Pipeline Behavior

* Each column shows lead count.  
* Leads can be dragged between stages manually.  
* AI can move stages automatically.  
* User can override AI at any time.  
* Clicking a lead opens the Lead Profile.  
* Pipeline updates in real time.

### Score Logic

The percentage shown on each column is the default score assigned to leads in that stage:

* Lost \= 5%  
* New Lead \= 10%  
* Contacted \= 25%  
* Engaged \= 45%  
* Qualified \= 65%  
* Appointment Set \= 80%  
* Active Client \= 90%  
* Under Contract \= 98%  
* Closed \= 100%

This score should feed Hot Leads, AI Intelligence, Dashboard rankings, and lead prioritization.

### Goal

Pipeline should be the visual source of truth showing exactly where every lead is in the journey from New Lead → Closed Deal, while AI automatically keeps stages updated from conversations.
